prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering the onboarding flow and adding preset fallback choices were helpful.
Interactive screen redesigns and desktop hint notifications hurt performance.
Copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, waiting info, hints, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions for preset fallback choices were underestimated.
Predictions were consistently too high for redesigns, hint notifications, copy changes, guidelines, layout tweaks, and waiting info.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +1.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: -5.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +11.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +5.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -8.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -4.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.6% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -1.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, new_flow: -1.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +13.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pre-Built Pet Archetype Flow: Introduce a streamlined sub-flow on the pick friend step with pre-configured pet archetypes to skip complex photo uploads. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (65.6%) and a high average completion time (mean 1017s), alongside 3 support complaints regarding custom pet generation errors.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Compatibility Check Screen: Insert a system compatibility verification screen right after the story step to verify graphics rendering before onboarding choices. (why: Multiple support emails reported the sign-in screen stalling (2 emails) or the pet failing to show on desktop/app failing to open (3 emails).)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Shift: Move sign-in to occur right after the adoption certificate is generated, ensuring pet data is locked to the account prior to waiting. (why: 8 users reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, suggesting account binding should happen after pet attributes are finalized.)
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Warmup Activity Screen: Add an engaging warmup screen before waiting that prepares desktop workspace boundaries. (why: The home stage waiting process suffers from long completion times (mean 2336s) causing user attrition prior to completing setup.)
4: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Render Status Indicators: Display explicit multi-phase progress step counters on the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: Waiting step takes a mean time of 2336s and 201s median, leading to user drop-offs before reaching final onboarding finish.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar Pinning Guidance Hint: Provide a helpful hint on home_intro explaining desktop taskbar access and pet control options. (why: 3 emails cited confusion on controlling/hiding pets and 3 cited issues with pet visibility on desktop.)

scores.note: High drop-off step with support evidence; preset flow changes historically perform well.
Adding new verification screens adds friction and requires a full app release.
Addresses major data loss issue; flow reordering has proven highly effective.
New interactive warmup screen adds friction and new screen changes tend to reduce conversion.
Waiting info tweaks show limited effect historically with low overall lift.
Addresses clear user complaints at low drop-off step, though hints have modest impact.
